pop_std = math.sqrt(var_pop)

# Sample std (Bessel-corrected)
sample_var = sum((v - mean)**2 for v in values) / (n - 1)
sample_std = math.sqrt(sample_var)

# Skewness (Fisher, sample-adjusted)
m3 = sum((v - mean)**3 for v in values) / n
g1 = m3 / (pop_std**3) if pop_std else 0

# Fisher-sample skewness
fisher_skew = ((n-1)/math.sqrt(n)) * g1 if g1 else 0

# Kurtosis (peaks, population)
m4 = sum((v - mean)**4 for v in values) / n
kurt = m4 / (var_pop**2) if var_pop else 0

# Excess kurtosis (sample-adjusted via unbiased-ish correction)
n3 = n * (n + 1)
n2s = (n - 1) * (n - 1)
n_minus_1 = n - 1
unbiased_m4 = (n / n_minus_1) * m4  # rough

excess_kurt_num = (n - 1) * ((n + 1) * m4 / n2s - 3 * var_pop**2)
excess_kurt = excess_kurt_num / (var_pop**2) if var_pop and n > 3 else None

def quantile_linear(data, q):
    s = sorted(data)
    n = len(s)
    idx = q * (n - 1)
    lo = int(math.floor(idx))
    hi = int(math.ceil(idx))
    frac = idx - lo
    if lo == hi:

    return s[lo] * (1 - frac) + s[hi] * frac
